canonical_title: Minimum intensities in any vertical plane of position lights

versions.title_at_revision: Minimum intensities in any vertical plane of position lights
versions.text: Each position light intensity must equal or exceed the applicable values in the following table: Angle above or below the horizontal plane Intensity 0 1.00 I. 0° to 5° 0.90 I. 5° to 10° 0.80 I. 10° to 15° 0.70 I. 15° to 20° 0.50 I. 20° to 30° 0.30 I. 30° to 40° 0.10 I. 40° to 90° 0.05 I.
